chars.AMINE: a 23-year-old Moroccan young man with short curly black hair and light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with white drawstrings and dark grey joggers
chars.SARA: a Moroccan young woman in her early twenties with long wavy dark-brown hair in a low ponytail, wearing a lilac oversized knit sweater and large round gold hoop earrings

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, a modest Moroccan apartment bedroom. SARA sits at a desk caught in the act, secretly copying paragraphs from a glowing chatbot window on her laptop into her document, a sly guilty half-smile, eyes darting to the side. Seen from the half-open doorway behind her shoulder, head-to-waist framing, her face clearly visible in three-quarter view. The laptop screen shows only blurry abstract lines, no readable text. Only one character.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, a small simple bedroom in a modest house in a small Moroccan town. AMINE sits on his bed with a laptop on his knees, leaning back in shock, eyes wide and mouth open, one hand on his head, staring at the screen. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, screen shows only blurry shapes, no readable text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: AMINE in his small bedroom at night, frowning, holding his phone with both thumbs and angrily sending a screenshot, a determined accusing look. Head-to-waist, face visible, phone screen glowing with blurry shapes, no readable text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: SARA on a sofa in her Moroccan apartment at night, annoyed and defensive, rolling her eyes and pressing hard on her phone screen with her thumb as if blocking someone, arms tense. Head-to-waist, face visible, comic exaggerated annoyance, phone screen shows no readable text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Early morning in AMINE's small bedroom with a simple wooden desk and a window with Moroccan iron grille. AMINE sits up straight at the desk with a determined face, rolling up his hoodie sleeves, ready to work alone, a notebook and laptop in front of him. Warm sunrise light.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: AMINE at his desk focused, copying his own old paragraphs from a long chat conversation on his phone into a document on his laptop, a calm proud small smile. Close medium shot, face visible, screens show only blurry lines, no readable text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: AMINE locked in his small bedroom surrounded by tall piles of books and crumpled papers, writing intensely on his laptop late at night with a glass of mint tea, tired but passionate, a calendar on the wall with many days crossed out. Face visible.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: AMINE standing in his small bedroom proudly holding up a finished printed paperback novel with a plain dark blue cover with no letters on it, big happy grin, eyes shining. Head-to-waist, face visible, warm daylight.
